QR Payment Queue
จัดคิวภาพ QR แล้วส่งต่อให้ K PLUS ทีละใบ

Import one or more QR screenshots, queue them, and hand each image to K PLUS through the Android share sheet. This app does not read the QR code — K PLUS does. You check the recipient and amount inside K PLUS and you confirm when a payment is done.

You stay in control of every payment

QR Payment Queue only copies, queues and shares QR images. It does not read or validate the QR code, never enters a PIN, password, OTP or biometric, never touches bank security screens, and never marks a payment as paid on its own.
Queue states: QUEUED → SHARING → WAITING_USER → COMPLETED (FAILED / UNKNOWN stop the queue for you)
